name: Hover.dev
summary: Animated, copy-paste components and page templates for React and Tailwind CSS, built with Framer Motion.
description: A library of animated components and sections for React and Tailwind CSS — navbars, heroes, pricing, forms, testimonials, stats, kanban boards, buttons, cards, carousels, loaders and more — each with a CODE toggle that reveals the source to paste into your project. Three full templates ship as well: Clean Neubrutalism, a Steam-style developer portfolio and The Startup. Free components plus a one-time Hover Pro unlock.
contains: Sections: 3D, FAQ, features, form, hero, kanban, pricing, sign-in, stats, testimonials
Components: accordions, buttons, calendars, cards, carousels, dropdown menus, inputs, loaders, modals
Components: countdown, grids, links, navbars & menus, notifications, progress, tabs, tables, text, toggles
copy source with the CODE toggle; free and Pro components
